next_step: Run Redwood perf benchmark with customer payloads + review quant profile
notes:
Snapshot from AE/SE calls and internal notes:
- Customer: LumenFlow builds real-time personalization and bidding adjustments for ad auctions. High QPS spikes during campaigns, strict tail latency needs.
- Primary ask: achieve predictable 95/99 pctl latency under heavy concurrency while minimizing per-token cost.  Interested in batching/caching/quantization levers and Redwood Optimize recommendations.
- Perf targets: P95 < 60ms, P99 < 120ms for typical interactive path (request ~ 64 tokens response), baseline throughput target 200 req/s sustained with bursts to 1k req/s.
- Model preference: open-model family (13B-30B often), want to evaluate quantized 8-bit/4-bit variants. Prefer Llama2-13B or similar that can be int8 quantized; willing to test trimmed-context variants.
- Caching strategy: prefix/KV cache for repeated user prefixes (session personalization), per-account TTLs, local KV hot-cache on dedicated nodes. Ask: demo of Redwood prefix caching and hit-rate improvements.
- Batching: dynamic batching with latency SLO enforcement; want to observe latency vs throughput curves with batching enabled/disabled. Request Redwood to show configuration suggestions (batch size, max latency window).
- Quantization: risk matrix discussion — quality vs perf. Want Redwood to run evals on 200-prompt promptset to measure regression with int8 and int4 quant. "Do we see hallucination or top-k shifts?" quoted from engineering lead.
- Bench request: run Redwood-managed perf run using customer payloads + synthetic spike scenarios. Deliverables: throughput-latency-cost matrix, token-cost estimate for 1M requests, recommended Dedicated pool sizing (GPU types + nodes), and Optimize settings (cache TTLs, batching rules, quant profile).
- Security/compliance: need SOC2 attestation, KMS/HSM integration for keying, and data residency in us-east for logs/metrics. Legal wants logging retention policy 12 months.
- Commercials: initial POC 3 months, then commit to reserved Dedicated (12-month) if SLOs met. CFO asking for ARR target <$500k first year.
- Quotes from calls: "If you can get P99 under 120ms at our load, we can move to reserved capacity." — Head of Platform.
- Small friction: procurement wants clearer cost model for hybrid (private + dedicated) setup. Also need redacted benchmark dataset for legal review.
